```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(facspseudocolor)
source(system.file("quarto", "_report-setup.R", package = "facspseudocolor"), local = TRUE)
analysis <- facs_report_input(params$config, params$analysis_rds)
report <- build_edu_pseudocolor_output_contract(analysis)
```

## Every-sample DNA-versus-EdU panels

```{r}
for (prefix in names(report$panels)) print(report$panels[[prefix]])
```

```{r}
report$panel_qc
```
